# Vendor Folder

Bootstrap, FontAwesome, dan confetti diload dari CDN.
Kalau mau offline, download manual:

1. Bootstrap CSS  -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
2. Bootstrap JS   -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
3. FontAwesome    -> https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css
4. Confetti       -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.9.3/dist/confetti.browser.min.js

Taruh di folder ini, lalu update src di index.html.
